# Cadastral Reference Type

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:CadastralReferenceType`](gmeow-CadastralReferenceType.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/CadastralReferenceType>
- **Category:** class
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/places`](../../slices/places.md)
- **Box roles:** [TBox role](../boxes/tbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The kind of a cadastral reference (parcel identifier, folio number, title number, lot number, survey plan reference, etc.). A value, not a subclass: the set is open-ended and they share all of [`CadastralReference`](gmeow-CadastralReference.md)'s structure, so a new kind is a new individual, not a new class ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)).

## Structure

**Subclass of:** [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue)

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:CadastralReferenceType`](gmeow-CadastralReferenceType.md) as a specialized kind of [`gufo:QualityValue`](../../external/terms.md#gufo-qualityvalue). Add statement metadata or a standpoint when the assertion needs provenance, confidence, or vantage.

## Usage Advice

### Use when

- Use to mint a new kind of cadastral reference as an individual on the open value vocabulary.

### Avoid when

- Avoid subclassing [`CadastralReference`](gmeow-CadastralReference.md) for a new kind ([Principle 9](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-9)).

### How to use

- Mint the kind as a [`gmeow:CadastralReferenceType`](gmeow-CadastralReferenceType.md) individual and reference it via [`gmeow:referenceType`](../properties/gmeow-referenceType.md).

### Examples

- ex:referenceTypeStrataPlan a [`gmeow:CadastralReferenceType`](gmeow-CadastralReferenceType.md).
